# Project Guidelines

## Agent Change Decision Records

Before making any agent-initiated change to this project, load and follow [the Technical Decision Documentation skill](./skills/technical-decision-documentation/SKILL.md). This applies to code, tests, documentation, configuration, and build files. Create and maintain one change-specific record in `context/technical-decisions/` before implementation, explain the rationale and tradeoffs for each meaningful step, record actual verification results, and link the record in the final response.
